note: A separate initial commissioning contract, not a relaxed full dataset. Missing valid IMU remains incomplete; diagnose with /imu/debug. No automatic actuation.

topics.name: /imu/data
topics.purpose: Original firmware IMU including source stamp; verify calibration, time sync and sample validity

topics.name: /motor_status
topics.purpose: Original firmware status; lack of motor freshness is expected with motor power disconnected

topics.name: /motor_fb
topics.purpose: Original firmware wheel feedback before bridge; reported values require matching fresh status, names and clock verification

topics.name: /imu/debug
topics.purpose: Firmware IMU diagnostics; not an estimator input

topics.name: /motor_enable
topics.purpose: Observed firmware enable requests; recording does not publish or disable motors

topics.name: /cmd_mit
topics.purpose: Observed MIT command; never replay on connected motors

topics.name: /cmd_torque
topics.purpose: Observed torque command, not measured torque

topics.name: /cmd_vel
topics.purpose: Observe unexpected velocity command publishers; recorder sends no commands

claim_scope: USB/IMU inventory only with motor power disconnected; no claim about encoders, motor response, navigation, slip, crossing or deployment.
